description: Spells any scale or chord with its correct note names, inversions and fingering (scale fingering from Hanon, 1873), draws it on a text keyboard, gives the key range of each keyboard size from 25 to 88 keys, and builds a practice plan for a level, goal and number of minutes. Each answer links to the Divux Piano page with that scale, chord or plan loaded for practice with a MIDI or on-screen keyboard. Applies to piano and keyboard theory, fingering, keyboard sizes and practice routines.

chord_quality.description: major, minor, diminished, augmented, sus2, sus4, dom7, maj7, min7, half_dim7, dim7, six, min6, add9 or dom9

inversion.description: 0 root position, 1 first inversion, 2 second, 3 third

kind.description: What to answer; worked out from the other fields when left out

minutes.description: For a plan: minutes a day, default 15

note.description: Scale tonic or chord root, e.g. 'C', 'F#', 'Bb', 'Eb3'

scale_type.description: major, natural minor, harmonic minor, melodic minor, dorian, phrygian, lydian, mixolydian, locrian, major pentatonic, minor pentatonic, blues or chromatic

name: learn_piano
title: Piano: scales, chords, keyboard sizes and practice plans
